Figure 1 review only. This notebook calls **metacoder::heat_tree**, not a
ggtree approximation. Both communities reuse the verified equal-sample mean
mapped-read abundances without refitting, renormalising or dropping taxa.
The prior global figures remain preserved. No manuscript changes.

The package authors recommend Reingold-Tilford initialisation followed by
Davidson-Harel layout: <https://grunwaldlab.github.io/metacoder_documentation/workshop--05--plotting.html>.
Package paper: Foster, Sharpton and Gruenwald (2017), doi:10.1371/journal.pcbi.1005404.
See `docs/metacoder_runtime.md` for the additive R library; no Conda environment.

```sh
PHAGE_UV_METACODER_LIB=/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/.local/share/R/phage-uv-metacoder-0.3.9 \
  bash scripts/run_qmd.sh analysis/native_metacoder_heat_trees.qmd NEW_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY
python3 tests/test_native_metacoder_heat_trees.py NEW_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY
```

```{r}
#| label: native-heat-trees
lib <- Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_METACODER_LIB")
if(nzchar(lib)) .libPaths(c(lib,.libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages({library(data.table); library(metacoder); library(ggplot2)})
check <- function(ok,msg) if(!isTRUE(ok)) stop(msg,call.=FALSE)
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
check(length(args)==1L,"Supply one new output directory")
output <- normalizePath(args[[1]],mustWork=FALSE)
check(!file.exists(output),"Output exists; choose a new version")
repo <- normalizePath(getwd())
source(file.path(repo,"R/figure_style.R"))
data <- normalizePath(Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_DATA_ROOT",
  "/Users/shaman.narayanasamy/Work/data/phage_uv_treatment/PRJEB79569"))
sources <- c(votu=file.path(data,"derived/votu_global_abundance_tree_2026-09-13-v3"),
  mag=file.path(data,"derived/mag_global_abundance_tree_2026-09-13-v2"))
hash <- function(p) substr(system2("shasum",c("-a","256",shQuote(p)),stdout=TRUE)[[1]],1,64)
input_records <- list()
dir.create(file.path(output,"figures"),recursive=TRUE)
dir.create(file.path(output,"tables"))
dir.create(file.path(output,"source"))
for(community in names(sources)) {
  input <- sources[[community]]
  manifest <- fread(file.path(input,"output_sha256.tsv"))
  paths <- c(nodes="tables/tree_nodes.tsv",labels="tables/tree_layout.tsv")
  if(community=="mag") paths <- c(paths,colours="tables/phylum_colour_key.tsv")
  for(kind in names(paths)) {
    rel <- paths[[kind]]; path <- file.path(input,rel)
    check(identical(hash(path),manifest[path==rel,sha256]),"Source differs from verified output")
    archived <- file.path(output,"source",paste0(community,"_",kind,".tsv"))
    check(file.copy(path,archived),"Failed to archive source")
    input_records[[length(input_records)+1L]] <- data.table(community=community,input=kind,path=path,sha256=hash(path))
  }
  nodes <- fread(file.path(input,paths[["nodes"]]))
  labels <- fread(file.path(input,paths[["labels"]]))
  check(nrow(nodes)==if(community=="mag")698L else 76L,"Unexpected node count")
  check(abs(nodes[node_id=="n000",clade_abundance]-1)<1e-12,"Root must sum to one")
  lab <- labels[match(nodes$node_id,label)]
  check(identical(lab$label,nodes$node_id),"Label alignment failed")
  colour_key <- if(community=="mag") {
    key <- fread(file.path(input,paths[["colours"]])); setNames(key$colour,key$phylum)
  } else c(phage_uv_viral_realm_colours,root="#666666")
  group <- if(community=="mag")nodes$phylum else nodes$realm
  colours <- unname(colour_key[group])
  check(!anyNA(colours),"Missing taxonomic colour")
  plotted <- copy(nodes)
  plotted[,`:=`(mean_percent=100*clade_abundance,colour=colours,
    plot_label=ifelse(lab$show_label,lab$label_text,""))]
  # Native labels have no leader lines. Avoid a central pile-up by labelling
  # MAG phyla >=1%; smaller phyla remain fully drawn and tabulated.
  if(community=="mag") plotted[rank=="phylum" & clade_abundance<.01,plot_label:=""]
  # The root now has its true 100% clade size, using native metacoder scaling.
  # Explicit intervals and zero minima give area proportional to abundance.
  # Text uses native metacoder positioning, with no rectangular label boxes.
  set.seed(913)
  # Native text measurement needs a device; do not create Rplots.pdf in Git.
  grDevices::pdf(file=NULL,width=13,height=11)
  p <- metacoder::heat_tree(
    taxon_id=plotted$node_id,supertaxon_id=plotted$parent,
    node_label=plotted$plot_label,node_size=plotted$mean_percent,
    edge_size=plotted$mean_percent,node_color=plotted$colour,edge_color=plotted$colour,
    node_size_trans="area",edge_size_trans="area",
    node_size_interval=c(0,100),edge_size_interval=c(0,100),
    node_size_range=c(0,.045),edge_size_range=c(0,.018),
    node_label_size=1,node_label_size_range=c(.013,.013),node_label_color="#252525",
    node_label_max=1000,repel_labels=TRUE,repel_force=2,repel_iter=3000,
    layout="davidson-harel",initial_layout="reingold-tilford",
    make_node_legend=TRUE,make_edge_legend=FALSE,
    node_legend_title=NA,node_size_axis_label="Mean relative abundance (%)",
    node_color_axis_label=NA,title=NULL,background_color="#FFFFFF",
    margin_size=c(.04,.04,.04,.04),verbose=TRUE)
  grDevices::dev.off()
  check(inherits(p,"ggplot"),"Expected native heat_tree ggplot result")
  # Keep native text positions and native ggfittext rendering. A subtle white
  # text halo improves contrast over branches; no label rectangles or borders.
  label_layer <- which(vapply(p$layers,function(x) inherits(x$geom,"GeomFitText"),logical(1)))
  check(length(label_layer)==1L,"Unexpected native label layer structure")
  native_labels <- p$layers[[label_layer]]
  halo <- lapply(seq(0,2*pi,length.out=9)[-9],function(angle) {
    shifted <- native_labels$data
    shifted$xmin <- shifted$xmin+.0008*cos(angle)
    shifted$xmax <- shifted$xmax+.0008*cos(angle)
    shifted$ymin <- shifted$ymin+.0008*sin(angle)
    shifted$ymax <- shifted$ymax+.0008*sin(angle)
    do.call(ggfittext::geom_fit_text,c(list(data=shifted,mapping=native_labels$mapping,
      inherit.aes=FALSE,colour="white"),native_labels$geom_params))
  })
  p$layers <- c(p$layers[-label_layer],halo,list(native_labels))
  fwrite(plotted,file.path(output,"tables",paste0(community,"_plotted_nodes.tsv")),sep="\t")
  saveRDS(p,file.path(output,"source",paste0(community,"_native_heat_tree.rds")))
  ggsave(file.path(output,"figures",paste0(community,"_native_heat_tree.pdf")),p,
    device=grDevices::pdf,useDingbats=FALSE,width=13,height=11,units="in")
  cat(community,":",nrow(nodes),"nodes;",sum(nzchar(plotted$plot_label)),"labels\n")
}
fwrite(rbindlist(input_records),file.path(output,"input_sha256.tsv"),sep="\t")
check(file.copy(file.path(repo,"analysis/native_metacoder_heat_trees.qmd"),file.path(output,"source/native_metacoder_heat_trees.qmd")),"Notebook archive failed")
fwrite(as.data.table(installed.packages()[,c("Package","Version","LibPath")]),file.path(output,"source/runtime_packages.tsv"),sep="\t")
writeLines(c("Native metacoder heat_tree review candidates; manuscript unchanged.",
  paste("metacoder",as.character(packageVersion("metacoder"))),
  "Layout: Reingold-Tilford initialisation, Davidson-Harel; seed 913. Native node/edge drawing and label repulsion; no ggtree or ggrepel substitution. Native text receives a subtle white halo for contrast, with no border boxes.",
  "Identical verified inclusive clade abundances: 634 qualifying vOTUs and 348 MAGs; 12 within-sample proportions averaged equally.",
  "Node area is proportional to mean relative abundance; edge widths use area (square-root) scaling. The root represents 100%, unlike the former decorative root marker.",
  "Taxonomic colours unchanged. MAG phylum labels require >=1% clade abundance to reduce central crowding; other label rules unchanged. No taxa filtered; 76 viral nodes and 698 MAG nodes.",
  "Parent and descendant values are nested, not additive. MAG and viral read denominators are separate; not absolute cross-community abundance or a temporal/treatment analysis.",
  "Taxonomic hierarchy only; branch lengths do not encode sequence divergence. Prior variants remain preserved.",
  "Reference: https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pcbi.1005404",
  capture.output(sessionInfo())),file.path(output,"REVIEW_README.txt"))
files <- list.files(output,recursive=TRUE,full.names=TRUE)
fwrite(data.table(path=substring(files,nchar(output)+2L),sha256=vapply(files,hash,character(1))),file.path(output,"output_sha256.tsv"),sep="\t")
```
